conservation_contract: A region or coarse pool has one spatial owner, area/volume/depth scope, tick and revision.
Cross-boundary stock, heat, movement and information transactions apply once; neighbor copies own no duplicate inventory.
Existing named people retain identity, kinship and knowledge carriers; no anonymous replacement on zoom.
Fine/coarse conversion partitions/recombines integer counts and extensive material/energy pools; temperature and averages are not inventories.
Materialization presently imports explicit boundary inventory; it is not refinement of an existing coarse ecosystem.
RNG/update-order changes require explicit versioning and declared replay/statistical acceptance criteria.
Unobserved state continues aging and acting; the camera never determines physical chronology.
open_endedness_contract: Recipes are subsequent descriptions of discovered operations/evidence, not effect grants or unlocks.
Larger creations need local physical connections and paid material/work, not only a larger cuboid cap.
Institutions require actual holders, communication, resources and scoped authorization/enforcement; names do not create authority.
Knowledge copying and loss need carriers; global index eviction cannot erase every retained account.
